raw_response.message: Access denied to chart 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000. You are not entitled to access this chart.

note: The all-zero UUID is specially allowlisted by the tool's own chart_id regex pattern (alongside all-f) as a syntactically-valid sentinel, distinct from a normal v1-8/8-b UUID. It is cleanly rejected with AUTHZ_DENIED — PASS, no special-case bypass.
